programme.title: 台灣好吃驚之高志部長趴趴走:26
programme.desc: 國興衛視自製新形態生活風格節目-台灣好吃驚精華內容，由日本演員松野高志主持，介紹台日文化大不同! 在台灣司空見慣的事,在日本人的眼裡看起來又是如何呢? 集結台灣好吃驚各種精華，由好吃驚部長-高志再次深入台灣各地,發掘台灣讓日本人驚奇的各種新鮮事以及文化美食,藉由高志部長與小夥伴們的挖掘,還會發現連台灣人也嘖嘖稱奇的事蹟!

programme.title: Matsuko不知道的世界:71
programme.desc: 以豪邁的作風與犀利的評論，讓觀眾喜愛不已的貴婦松子所主持的談話節目，每期討論的主題包羅萬象，從美食類的抹茶甜點在地沾醬咖哩麵包，到其他類型的鍵盤點活世界，以及交友軟體等，並由對該領域極度著迷的專家進行介紹，一起揭開這令人驚奇，且不為人知的世界！

programme.title: 今天愛上我
programme.desc: 帶領高雄慈青團隊的溫玉香師姊，團隊中的成員有著各自的問題，為愛委曲求全的文雅落魄富二代的璽中表面活潑卻是社恐的敬文一言不合就冷戰的宜鑫隨後陪伴正修慈青社的麗雪師姊，面臨倒社又遇上了叛逆來踢館的賴郁文年青人們不同的人生際遇，因緣際會聚在慈青團隊，他們如何面對自我

programme.title: 大愛醫生館

programme.title: 人文講堂
programme.desc: 人文講堂節目，邀請臺灣各行各業傑出人士學者專家，或熱愛生命者，將多年的學識涵養人文感受，以及對生命的活力，以二十-二分鐘的講演方式，直接與大眾分享講演的內容及方式，不再流於傳統，不僅是知識或專業技術而已，更會呈現出特有的人文觀點

programme.title: 銀髮白之歌-靜曦
programme.desc: 參訪精舍後得知建院迫切，開始募款慈院落成，開始志工體系人多意見相左，靜曦疲解釋，返回台北偶遇先前插花課的學生，一起插最後一盆花靜曦重返花蓮一心求死的老榮民以為已施行安樂死，沈睡隔天發現自己復活後再也不嚷著想死父母相繼過世，臨終前母親將女兒託付給慈璧母喪後靜曦隨即回醫院，和泉溪伯撞見了彼此的喪慟，教學樂器忘卻痛苦多年後，老榮民成為大體老師靜曦成為清修士

programme.title: 毀滅者
programme.desc: 原本平靜的生活，卻因為不速之客闖入，出現巨大變化自妻子死後，他與女兒在倫敦過著隱姓埋名的生活，直到幾名毒販搞錯地址闖入家中，為了保護女兒卡莉，他出手制止，卻不慎將毒販擊斃，行蹤因新聞報導而暴露，被軍火商查爾斯發現，一面派出頂尖殺手刺殺他，一面尋找被警方安置保護的卡莉如今，曾是美國聯邦探員的他，將要如何在被追殺中保護女兒安危呢？！

programme.title: 致命羅密歐

programme.title: 美國狙擊手

programme.title: 陀地驅魔人
programme.desc: 他不但能看見鬼，還能與鬼溝通認為鬼的怨氣需要化解，而不是捕捉的驅鬼大師黃永發，藉由一張嘴驅逐惡鬼好友阿蔥將整個驅鬼過程上傳網路，引來狗仔隊女記者方紫寧的注意，希望能藉由報導驅鬼過程成名為了報導新聞，紫寧不慎惹鬼上身，幾乎喪命，幸好永發出手相救，紫寧因此對他暗生傾慕某日，紫寧偷偷潛入永發家中，意外發現他竟與女鬼同居

programme.title: 不可能的任務-鬼影行動
programme.desc: 阿湯哥慘遭陷害，沒有支援，沒有選擇，只能自尋生路克里姆林宮遭受恐怖爆炸攻擊，美國政府為此啟動鬼影行動，徹底否認不可能任務情報局及其特工伊森杭特在失去所有支援情況下，伊森與一群被撤銷職權的逃亡探員，必須在沒有官方紀錄或後援情況下，阻止一場全球核武戰爭發生在危機四伏的追逐中，伊森杭特不僅要證明自己的清白，更要趕在世界末日來臨前，完成這項不可能的任務！

programme.title: 蠟筆小新-新婚旅行風暴 奪回廣志大作戰
programme.desc: 澳洲的祕境古雷特巴巴布里夫島上，野原一家人正盡情享受遲來的蜜月旅行，這天夜晚廣志卻突然失蹤了經過一番尋找，野原家發現假面族的村子正在舉行華麗婚禮，而廣志以新郎的模樣參加其中原來島上有個傳說，如果在五十年一次的金環日食當天將新郎獻給公主殿下，就可以獲得寶物作為獎賞而這次被選為新郎的人就是廣志野原家為了奪回廣志，與假面族和一群尋寶獵人展開了激烈的廣志爭奪戰

programme.title: 越來越嗖鯊
programme.desc: 越來越嗖鯊！（Xu?t s?c）是公視兒少新住民語言學習節目--越南系列嗖鯊是越南語Xu?t s?c的諧音，也是厲害出色的意思收視觀眾由原本6-12歲的學齡兒童，擴大至家長老師以致於全民節目方向已不只為了要新二代學媽媽的語言，而是要認識台灣多數人的語言主持人-阮秋姮節目中扮演嗖鯊甜點坊老闆，其開朗熱心又有點調皮的個性，成為來店大小顧客解決問題的聊天對象，其和店員嗖鯊哥及來賓，產生有趣的互動，進而瞭解越南語言及文化

programme.title: 歡迎光臨我的牧場2
programme.desc: 歡迎光臨我的牧場第二季全新集數，從兒童視角探索台灣牧場與動物科普本集來到桃園龜山的螞蟻主題館，記錄小主人宸翊與妹妹每天與上百蟻巢為伍的日常從餵食清潔到觀察築巢，孩子在微小卻充滿秩序的螞蟻世界中學習耐心與責任，並在家人支持下建立對生命的理解與情感，讓興趣化為成長的養分

programme.title: 小書痴的下剋上
programme.desc: 從小就是個超級書痴的女大學生麗乃，愛書愛到希望在書堆裡死去該說是夢想成真嗎？好不容易應徵上圖書館工作的她，卻在地震時被掉落的書給活埋當她再度醒過來，發現自己竟然轉生到了陌生的異世界，變成名叫梅茵的五歲小女孩，不但生在貧窮的士兵家，而且還體弱多病，但最讓她難以接受的是，這個世界完全找不到任何書店或圖書館，就算想看書，也是一般平民根本買不起的天價！於是梅茵下定決心：既然買不到書，那我就自己動手做！憑藉著對書的滿腔熱情，目標是成為圖書管理員為了在異世界也能過著被書環繞的美好生活，就從做書開始努力吧！

programme.desc: 越來越嗖鯊！（Xu?t s?c）是公視兒少新住民語言學習節目--越南系列嗖鯊是越南語Xu?t s?c的諧音，也是厲害出色的意思收視觀眾由原本6-12歲的學齡兒童，擴大至家長老師以致於全民節目方向已不只為了要新二代學媽媽的語言，而是要認識台灣多數人的語言主持人-阮秋姮節目中扮演嗖鯊甜點坊老闆，其開朗熱心又有點調皮的個性，成為來店大小顧客解決問題的聊天對象，其和店員嗖鯊哥及來賓，產生有趣的互動，進而瞭解越南語言及文化

programme.title: 喵的詐騙集團
programme.desc: 神奇街貓莫里斯不僅會說話，還聰明絕頂他和偽裝成吹笛手的基斯以危險豆豆為首的老鼠群，想出了一個完美的賺錢計畫，聯手詐騙純樸小鎮的人們莫里斯先去恐嚇人們將有鼠疫，再派老鼠們在小鎮出沒，然後讓基斯假扮吹笛手，以笛聲驅趕老鼠離開，果然獲得人們豐厚的報酬但老鼠們不想再繼續騙下去，他們執意想去快樂天堂島，?個老鼠和人類可以和平共處的聖地莫里斯於是要求他們再進行最後一次詐騙，藉此籌措前往聖地的旅費

programme.desc: 小新偶遇神秘少女萊夢，在萊夢的指導訓練下，小新成為正義間諜，與萊夢並肩作戰但小新被選為正義間諜的原因為何，指派的任務又隱藏著什麼危機? 今年暑假，野原新之助面臨史上最危險與最KUSO的任務正義背叛友情秘密，一個呆呆的五歲幼稚園小朋友和他的家人，被捲入一場關係人類未來的巨大陰謀!

programme.title: 哆啦A夢劇場版-大雄與綠之巨人傳
programme.desc: 大雄背著媽媽偷偷養著一株小樹苗為了讓小樹苗能自由活動，哆啦A夢用植物自動液將小樹苗變成一個小男孩，取名為樹寶討人喜愛的樹寶讓大雄好似多了一個弟弟，家中也因此歡笑不斷樹寶不僅很快學會讀書寫字，也愛看新聞吸取新知跟懶散的大雄比起來，樹寶顯得聰明且伶俐呢！

programme.title: 蠟筆小新-春日部野生王國
programme.desc: 小新一家人居住的春日部市正在倡導愛護地球的環保活動，於是小新也和大家一起撿垃圾在這時小新撿到了一罐飲料，帶回家後卻意外的被爸爸廣志和媽媽美?喝掉，而喝下飲料的他們居然分別變成了雞和豹變成動物的廣志和美?也不認得小新和他的妹妹小葵了，這一切似乎都是邪惡組織正在進行的人類動物計畫，而小新這次也將挺身而出對抗惡勢力

programme.title: 超次元英雄 卡邦無限
programme.desc: 宇宙其實是由無限個宇宙交疊而成，每個宇宙都擁有不同代號的多元地球在多元地球 0073，地球已進入人類與外星人共生的時代，但利用情感機關操控情感引發危害的犯罪事件卻不斷發生銀河聯邦警察搜查官弩城怜慈，同時也是唯一的宇宙刑警卡邦，奉命跨越不同次元，秘密調查情感機關犯罪遇上危機時，他將透過蒸著變身卡邦，在混亂的次元空間中展開戰鬥！

programme.title: 龍的傳人
programme.desc: 周飛鴻元華飾性格忠直，周小龍周星馳飾自幼受父薰陶，與師妹毛毛毛舜筠飾青梅竹馬，但小龍不甘毛毛痴纏，兩人逐成歡喜冤家飛鴻師弟毛仁梁家仁飾，到大澳避債，飛鴻卻托毛仁帶小龍到市區發展，毛仁無中發現小龍在打卓球方面甚有天份，故利用小龍賭波，賺取鉅款，及後毛仁更騙取飛鴻在大澳的地契作為賭注，到比賽前才得悉毛仁的陰謀，小龍大失水準，結果落敗飛鴻輸掉地契，被趕離大澳

programme.title: 天作之合

programme.title: 西遊記之仙履奇緣
programme.desc: 誰知至尊寶能拔出她手中的紫青寶劍，所以紫霞仙子則認定至尊寶才是她的情人，但此時月光寶盒卻不在紫（青）霞仙子手中，次日晚上，至尊寶回到旁觀觀音大士大戰孫悟空橋段，而月光寶盒則在其中，原來孫悟空是受不了唐僧太過碎碎唸，觀音菩薩後來也受不了唐三藏太過碎碎唸，而月光寶盒則在觀與孫兩人鬥法中甩來甩去，月光寶盒最後被至尊寶拿到手，卻陰錯陽差把唐三藏弄入另外一時空中，月光寶盒也隨之弄入另外一時空中

programme.title: 整人專家
programme.desc: 男主角劉德華周星馳，女主角關之琳邱淑貞，在王晶的精密推算下，雙生雙旦，加上層出不窮的整蠱橋段，影片於九一年農歷上映賣過滿堂紅周星馳以替人整蠱為業，一次受聘於默基對付劉德華，使他不能接近關之琳，他設計假扮成劉德華的失散兄弟，進行整蠱行動，然而，日久相處，星爺漸被劉德華的真情感動

programme.desc: 紅領巾軍被孫悟空滅掉的30年後，雷德統帥的兒子瑪仙達欲重組紅領巾軍來實現當時父親的野心，並矇騙了蓋洛博士的孫子海德博士來實現野心

programme.title: 鬼滅之刃竈門炭治郎立志篇1-5
programme.desc: 夯遍全亞洲，值得一看時代背景為日本大正時期賣炭維生的善良少年炭治郎，某天家人慘遭鬼殺害而唯一倖存的妹妹禰豆子，卻變化成鬼遭到絕望現實打擊的炭治郎，為了讓妹妹恢復回人類，為了被殺害的家人向鬼報仇，決定踏上獵鬼之路人鬼交織的悲憤兄妹故事，現在開始了

programme.title: 你在天空彼岸
programme.desc: 劇情描述女高中生小澪意識到自己對青梅竹馬阿新的感情，卻因無法傳達讓兩人陷入微妙的關係某天，兩人因一點小事起了爭執，為了挽回與阿新的情誼，小澪不顧大雨前往阿新的所在之處，卻因此遭遇車禍然而，出現在恢復意識的小澪眼前的，是一個從未見過的神秘世界

programme.title: 配對遊戲
programme.desc: 劇情描述一對男女透過時下最流行的交友軟體APP相識，寂寞單身的兩人體驗速食愛情的同時，也在彼此的身上找到了陪伴，然而隨著做愛情專欄編輯的男方，因為工作需要將兩人交往的過程匿名刊登於網路寫成小說，並因此成為人氣網路作家，女方得知之後覺得自己被利用而憤怒不已，從性開始的愛情，當面臨考驗的時候也開始搖搖欲墜，究竟所謂命中注定的愛情是否存在？兩人的愛情可以修成正果嗎？

programme.title: 新解釋・三國志
programme.desc: 距今1800年前，中國大陸處於魏蜀吳三國群雄割據的時代在這亂世中，為重返太平盛世，被後人視為英雄的蜀國武將．劉備崛起，在劉備與各國武將們奔騰的熱血時代，終於發生了赤壁之戰，這是一場魏國80萬大軍對上蜀國與吳國的3萬聯軍的兵力懸殊之戰

programme.title: 鹿鼎記2神龍教
programme.desc: 龍兒（林青霞飾）重返神龍教繼承教主之職位，並奉命保護平西王吳三桂（秦沛飾）之子吳應祥（湯鎮業飾），前往京城晉見康熙（溫兆倫飾），並在麗春院巧遇韋小寶（周星馳飾）及阿珂（李嘉欣飾）康熙賜婚，命小寶護送建寧公主（邱淑貞飾）下嫁至雲南．．．

programme.title: 拆彈專家2
programme.desc: 香港發生連環爆炸案，令全城人心惶惶前拆彈專家潘乘風（劉德華飾）昏迷於案發現場，被警方列為頭號嫌疑犯，懷疑他跟邪惡組織復生會有密切聯繫甦醒後的潘乘風，面對警方施壓式的盤問和牢獄之災，決定逃走親自查明真相在孤立無援的絕路上，潘乘風找他的戰友拆彈專家董卓文（劉青雲飾）協助，但由於二人陷入黑白不明的矛盾狀況，董卓文必須在公私之間作出抉擇基於出生入死的友情，他決定向摯友伸出援手同時，潘乘風前女友龐玲（倪妮飾），現為反恐特勤隊總督察，急於查出連環爆炸案的幕後黑手，以確保市民安全，她說服潘乘風接觸復生會，追查這神秘組織的下一步恐襲計劃，以證明他的清白然而，令潘乘風最意想不到的, 竟是揭破真相就如拆除炸彈般危險艱鉅，在爭分奪秒中隨時送命

programme.title: 海角七號
programme.desc: 1945年第二次世界大戰結束後，臺灣的日治時代終結，進入中華民國時代，日本人被全數遣返回日本本土12月，一位日本籍教師在高砂丸遣返船上，一字一句寫下給他臺灣籍女學生兼愛人小島友子的七封情書信封上簡單寫著台?恒春郡海角七番地小島友子?，但隨著兩人分離兩地另組家庭，成了寄不出去的七封情書

programme.title: 金派特務
programme.desc: 根據線報，大量走私槍枝即將流入韓國，菜鳥特務流茶熙被指派前往韓國進行機密調查，為確保任務順利，進而尋求國情局的優秀臥底協助，卻陰錯陽差遇上笨手笨腳又貪財的私家偵探禹手罕兩人聯手調查，不僅零默契且漏洞百出，還讓相關人證都莫名被消失，甚至被當成頭號嫌疑犯！究竟這兩個超母湯特務，能不能保全性命，並順利完成任務呢？

programme.title: 航海王:1117
programme.desc: 偉大航路的黃金梅利號阿拉巴斯坦的王女．薇薇也在船上被稱為沙漠之國的阿拉巴斯坦王國，從以前就一直被不降雨的異常氣像所困擾，為人民著想的國王．寇布拉身邊，人人和平的生活著但是距今兩年前，雨變得只落在國王所居住的城市裡，同時間，世界政府禁止製造持有的人工降雨粉．跳舞粉也運往國王的身邊這事件成為國王與人民分裂的開端相信身為父親也是國王．寇布拉的薇薇，為了要把引起這異常氣像並陷害國王的邪惡組織的身分曝光而離開她的國家而現在為了阻止萬惡根源卻是國家英雄的克洛克達爾，薇薇和魯夫等夥伴一同前往阿拉巴斯坦為了奪回被奪走的重要東西而奔走！

programme.desc: 獲得百想藝術大獎最佳新人男演員 入圍青龍電影獎最佳女配角 從小因父親重男輕女，貞仁（申惠善 飾演）在中學時就逃家自力更生，與家人斷了聯繫貞仁後來憑一己之力成為頂級辯護律師，在一次偶然中，她得知罹患失智症的母親花子（裴宗玉 飾演）涉嫌殺害父親，同時還對不少無辜民眾下毒手 懷疑事有蹊翹的貞仁決定親自出馬，在層層阻撓下，她該如何為母親翻供，揭開這個樁謀殺案背後不可告人的真相？

programme.title: 少女殺手特急便
programme.desc: 主角菊野溪（橋本環奈 飾）表面上是一名正在就讀商業專門學校留著一頭粉紅色短髮的軟萌大學生然而，她的私下身份卻是派遣公司指名率第一名的王牌兼職殺手！

programme.title: 錢不夠用3-全部夠用
programme.desc: 阿輝阿強與阿煌，三名甘榜年代的好兄弟，在多年後各自有了自己的生活與家庭胸無大志的阿輝及強勢的妻子輝嫂，希望剛退役的兒子Roy能繼承自家的潮州粥店祖業，然而卻因為Roy鄙視把自己養大的傳統飲食行業，而遭到無情的拒絕，令阿輝兩夫妻萌生了賣店套現退休享清福的想法

programme.title: 赤狐書生
programme.desc: 清貧書生王子進赴京趕考途中遇見下凡取丹的小狐妖白十三白十三為了晉升狐仙，假意陪王子進趕考，其實是要讓子進主動獻出丹前往京城的路途遙遠又充滿危險，一人一狐相互扶持共患難成了莫逆之交歷盡萬險，終於到了白十三在友情與成仙之間作出抉擇的時候??

programme.title: 尋龍訣
programme.desc: 盜墓高手胡八一（陳坤 飾）決定金盆洗手他與未婚妻Shirley楊（舒琪 飾）移居美國，婚禮前，發現二十年前死在百眼窟的初戀對象丁思甜（Angelababy 飾）居然還活著老胡決定聯手Shirley楊及老搭擋王凱旋（黃勃 飾）再度踏入千年古墓，卻發現流傳千年的驚天秘密

programme.title: 名偵探柯南-第11位前鋒
programme.desc: 柯南和少年偵探團參加了由現任職業足球員教練的足球課程在那裡，小五郎與大學三年級的?木涼介重逢他目前執教一支青少年足球隊，但曾有在重要比賽中自擺烏龍而錯過冠軍的慘痛經歷...

programme.title: 花漾奶奶金難搞
programme.desc: 從早到晚每天忙碌打工的清寒大學生韓志雄，為了節省每個月高昂的租屋開銷，參加了社區推行的青銀共居計畫，沒想到迎接他的卻是性格古怪個性龜毛愛貪小便宜三天兩頭就往醫院跑，人人都敬而遠之的金芬奶奶

programme.title: 新封神榜-楊戩
programme.desc: 取材自經典神話封神演義，從楊戩被迫封印天眼神通，法力大減開始，他轉而成為一位賞金獵人，然而一名神秘女子婉羅找上楊戩，委託他去追捕一名叫沉香的少年，並尋回法力無邊的寶蓮燈沉香企圖用寶蓮燈的法力劈開華山，拯救被壓在蓮花峰下的母親卻不知此舉將會放出被鎮壓在其中的滅世玄鳥，為天下蒼生帶來毀天滅地的災禍而楊戩為了阻止沉香，意外揭開一樁塵封已久的秘密

programme.title: 大顯神威
programme.desc: 保坪宮第十八代師公-王富貴，人稱豬哥仙，其實是個逢賭必輸的落魄師公沒想到遇見了美豔動人的阿飄晴霞，從此時來運轉，但好運總要付出代價的原來，晴霞當年是紅透半邊天的歌姬，為了愛香消玉殞，含冤遊蕩在陰陽兩界這次找上豬哥仙，要他大顯神威，解開謎底

programme.title: 周處除三害
programme.desc: 劇情描述通緝犯陳桂林（阮經天 飾）在角頭大哥告別式上囂張尋仇，卻發現自己竟然只是排名第三的通緝犯，於是他查出前兩名通緝犯的下落，要將他們一一除掉

programme.desc: 一名年輕母親，26 歲的莎蓮雅瑞德，被發現慘遭殺害並遺棄在汽車內警方在路易斯安那州哈蒙德這個小鎮內展開地毯式搜查，誓要找出兇手

programme.title: 殺手調查第1季:2
programme.desc: 蘇珊莫爾丁在佛羅里達州的家中進行翻修時失一系列的銀行紀錄和監控畫面將偵探們引向黑暗的家庭秘密，以及一個兇手扭曲的計劃

programme.title: 惡魔在身邊第6季:7
programme.desc: 青少年馬修哈德曼被稱為吸血鬼殺手，他認為殺人可讓自己長生不死他的受害者是一名年長的鄰居他在刺殺鄰居之後，取出她的心臟並喝她的血

programme.title: 惡魔在身邊第6季:8
programme.desc: 問題少女艾莉莎布斯塔曼特自稱壞女孩，並且表示想知道殺人是什麼感覺她順從了這樣的好奇心，殺害了九歲的鄰居伊莉莎白奧爾滕

programme.title: 法庭現場第6季:149
programme.desc: 觀察最瘋狂的法庭時刻憤怒的被告人在虛擬聽證會對法官比中指；受害者遭到受指控的攻擊者交叉詰問等

programme.title: 法庭現場第6季:150
programme.desc: 觀察最瘋狂的法庭時刻受指控的跟蹤者對法官大喊髒話；槍擊受害者的母親哭喊要討個公道；助理檢察官與法官辯論等

programme.title: 奧札克執法實錄第1季:9
programme.desc: 十萬輛轟鳴作響的重型機車湧入歐扎克湖地區，參加本季最具代表性的重大活動，而歐扎克湖與歐塞奇海灘警局也必須與州警聯手合作

programme.title: 汽車旅館命案第1季:1
programme.desc: 2021年7月1日，賓州福爾斯鎮區福爾斯鎮區警方接獲一名女性打來卻沒有回應的電話，於是前往New Falls汽車旅館

programme.title: 偵訊實境第2季:12
programme.desc: 天剛亮，調查人員就趕往當地醫院，一名年長的女性在經過六小時的殘忍攻擊後，正在與死亡奮戰雖然受傷了，但受害者仍然可以描繪出兇殘的攻擊場景

programme.title: 死因解謎:5
programme.desc: 在進行社會福利訪查時，負責人員發現男子與家人的木乃伊屍體住在一起病理學家無法判定他們是自然死亡，還是發生了罪案

programme.title: 毒品走私集團追蹤
programme.desc: 在追查這名毒品走私者多年後，警方終於收到線報成功將他逮捕，但他緘默不語警方必須在8小時內查明他的身分來歷並逮捕整個犯罪集團

programme.title: 衝鋒警犬第1季:8

programme.title: 法庭現場第6季:169
programme.desc: 觀察最瘋狂的法庭時刻一名拘留中的男子試圖大膽逃離法庭；主權公民與法官爭論法律等

programme.title: 阿拉斯加州警第9季:10

programme.title: 美墨獵逃:8

programme.title: 法證先鋒4:27
programme.desc: 香港法證部高級化驗師高安法醫科高級醫生聞家希西九龍重案組高級督察郭輝煌，這滅罪鐵三角帶領著精英團隊，用專業的法證科學，揭示驚人的預謀策劃；用精密的法醫知識，破解隱蔽的人體密碼；用嚴謹的執法精神，披露震撼的罪惡真相！熱血記者徐意，童年憾事竟與高安緊扣牽連；法證專才水慧明，遭至愛背叛頓成殺人疑兇

programme.title: 真情:30

programme.title: 天天天晴:87

programme.desc: 事情緣起於傻仔丁常旺，旺本是豪門富商包慶豐九代單傳的獨子，旺母本是包老爺的妾侍，因原配夫人妒忌，誣捏旺母與家樸有染，包老爺盛怒之下，視有了身孕的旺母是懷有孽種，把旺母逐出家門，旺母流落異鄉並誕下旺，兩母子過了二十幾年相依為命的艱苦生活而包老爺二十多年來仍無子嗣，直至原配夫人患病去迦後，包老爺有感膝下無子承繼家產，遂派親侄包大業往尋旺兩母子，知不尋獲，包老爺寧願臨老續娶求子，也不會把家業傳給親侄大業一直欲承繼包老爺家產，如今希望幻滅，遂起歪心，在尋到旺兩母子時，暗中加害之，旺母死，旺被打傷後腦滾下山崖業以為旺已死，即找來一個身份卑賤的孤兒，頂包假冒包老爺之子，改名為包繼宗大業並編造故事，令繼宗亦以為自己就是流落在外的包家少爺

programme.desc: 很多人都說法律只保護懂法律的人，但法律其實不難懂，它甚至和你我的生活息息相關，無論是租屋購物婚姻家庭旅行等都可能扯上法律；一般人遇到了總是慌了手腳，不知如何處理甚至抱持著鴕鳥心態選擇置之不理，最後有可能造成更加難以收拾的局面！節目特別以專業律師團及藝人的精彩案例為主軸，透過他們親身經歷的真實故事，帶出一般民眾常見的法律困擾，讓觀眾在輕鬆的氛圍中了解及面對生活周遭的法律問題懂得保護自己，不再害怕法律

programme.desc: Untuk episod ini, Engku Syafiq sebagai hos bersama pendaki-pendaki Malaysia akan mendaki Gunung Irau, dan meliputi segala aspek dari segi sejarah, keselamatan dan kemahiran.

programme.title: Kembara
programme.desc: Bersama Hos, Azizul Ammar membawa penonton mengembara dan mencuba pelbagai aktiviti luar di Santai Dusun, Pengkalan Hulu.

programme.title: Mariposa
programme.desc: Acha, pelajar baharu yang ceria dan penuh tekad, jatuh cinta pandang pertama dengan Iqbal, seorang pelajar pintar yang terkenal dengan sikapnya yang sangat dingin. Iqbal diibaratkan seperti seekor rama-rama Mariposa, setiap kali cuba didekati, dia pasti akan melarikan diri. Walaupun sering ditolak oleh Iqbal, Acha tetap enggan berputus asa, tanpa menyedari bahawa Iqbal sebenarnya sedang bergelut dengan tekanan berat daripada keluarganya.

programme.title: CELEBS DAY OFF

programme.title: Trendsetter
programme.desc: Trendsetter adalah rancangan mengenai trend fesyen dan gaya hidup. Kini kembali dalam musim terbaru bersama pengacara Zakuan Zainal. Episod kalini menampilkan The Kit Locker dalam segmen Usha Kedai, Gaya Kerjaya Qif dan Bedah Kotak kasut Anaabu - Asymmetrical Blazer

programme.title: HURU HARA
programme.desc: Huru hara ini membincangkan tentang dunia hiburan, perjalanan kerjaya tetamu jemputan dan persembahan artis. Artis jemputan pada episod kali ini adalah Alicia Amin, Immanuel Santosh, Eva Kamilia dan Pitahati.

programme.title: Milea Extended
programme.desc: Kisah cinta ikonik 90-an antara Dilan dan Milea kini diceritakan sepenuhnya daripada perspektif Dilan. Saksikan versi lanjutan yang membongkar babak terpadam penuh emosi, konflik dunia geng motor, serta kehadiran Ancika sebelum takdir mempertemukan semula Dilan dan Milea di majlis reuni sekolah.

programme.title: Bisikan Pontianak
programme.desc: Selepas ditinggalkan suaminya, Suraya membesarkan dua orang anaknya sendirian di sebuah rumah terpencil. Namun apabila bekas suaminya kembali untuk menuntut tanah warisan, kejadian-kejadian aneh mula menghantui kampung mereka, memaksa keluarga itu berdepan dengan rahsia silam yang selama ini tersembunyi.

programme.title: Dont Blink
programme.desc: Sepuluh orang tiba di sebuah pusat peranginan pergunungan yang terpencil dan mendapati ia lengang sepenuhnya. Tanpa minyak untuk perjalanan pulang, para pengunjung terpaksa tinggal dan menyiasat misteri di sekitar pondok yang terbengkalai itu.

programme.title: Black S2 EP10
programme.desc: Black bertekad untuk menuntut keadilan ke atas nyawa yang hilang dan dihancurkan oleh penjenayah yang masih berleluasa.

programme.title: Golden Job
programme.desc: Sekumpulan bekas tentera upahan bersatu semula untuk merancang rompakan epik: meningkatkan trak penuh ubat yang dipegang oleh agensi perisikan asing untuk membekalkan kem pelarian yang memerlukan. Tetapi apabila mereka mendapati trak itu benar-benar dipenuhi dengan emas yang dicuri, kumpulan saudara-saudara itu menyedari bahawa mereka telah diserang dua kali oleh salah seorang daripada mereka sendiri - dan meletakkan keadaan yang betul akan menjadi perang habis-habisan.

programme.title: Rajawali
programme.desc: Rajawali mengisahkan penggodam yang diupah Komang untuk memecah sistem komputer ciptaan Arwin, namun program itu merupakan ritual ilmu hitam digital. Arwin dirasuk oleh program tersebut, manakala Komang terjerumus ke kegelapan.

programme.desc: Alia seorang wanita yang mirip tak tumpah seperti Affiyah.Dia sering diganggu mimpi didatangi seorang pemain biola wanita yang menuduhnya sebagai pembunuh. Zacky pula berhadapan dengan masalah diugut dan dibelasah kerana enggan menyertai satu kejohanan tinju. Dr Flora yang merawat Zacky sempat melihat sekeping gambar Zacky bersama Affiyah. Dr Flora terkejut dan memberitahu Zacky bahawa dia ada seorang kakitangan bernama Alia yang saling tak tumpah mirip Affiyah. Zacky lebih mementingkan diri untuk bertemu Alia sehingga sanggup mengenepikan urusan perniagaan keluarga. Sikapnya itu menimbulkan ketegangan ahli keluarga.Setelah membuat helah Zacky berjaya menemui Alia di klinik Dr Flora

programme.desc: Nor dan suaminya, Khuzairi tinggal di sebuah banglo bersama dua anak mereka. Selepas melahirkan anak kedua, Nor pulang ke rumah dan ibunya datang untuk menjaganya. Dia perasan bahawa pembantu rumahnya, Bella telah hilang. Bella seperti adik kepada Nor dan dia tinggal bersama mereka. Suaminya mengatakan bahawa Bella telah kembali ke Amsterdam untuk berkahwin. programme.title: Soal Hati
programme.desc: Daniel ialah seorang lelaki playboy kaya yang mempunyai perniagaan yang berjaya. Dia mula berubah setelah jatuh cinta pandang pertama dengan Nurul Ain, seorang gadis kampung yang bekerja sebagai jurujual. Daniel berusaha untuk memikat Nurul Ain dengan berpura-pura menjadi seorang lelaki biasa bernama Ahmad namun akhirnya diketahui oleh Nurul Ain. Dapatkan Daniel memikat hati Nurul Ain kembali?

programme.title: Seri Dewi Malam
programme.desc: Cinta seorang isteri kepada suami yang sangat kuat membuatkannya ingin terus berjuang untuk hidup. Azri menemui jalan untuk berkomunikasi bersama isterinya, Seri yang jatuh koma. Dewi, seorang gadis buta yang memboleh membaca minda memutuskan untuk membantu Azri berhubung dengan Seri. Lama kelamaan, perasaan cinta mula muncul dan Azri harus membuat pilihan yang sukar.

programme.title: Lurah Dendam
programme.desc: Sekumpulan ahli payung terjun yang diketuai Kapten Hanafi dalam penerbangan untuk membuat penerjunan di Kuantan. Kapal terbang yang mereka naiki terlanggar seekor burung helang dan mengakibatkan pesawat itu bergegar. Dalam keadaan kelam kabut itu, seorang demi seorang penerjun melompat keluar dan mendarat di sebuah kawasan hutan. Di sana, mereka diganggu pelbagai peristiwa dan menganggap tempat itu berpuaka. Namun, Kapten Hanafi mengesyaki semua peristiwa itu adalah berpunca daripada perbuatan manusia.

programme.title: Perjanjian Syaitan
programme.desc: Tambun membunuh Tok Kadim, penghulu di sebuah kampung dan kemudiannya mengatakan bahawa Tok Kadim mati satu kemalangan. Selepas kejadian itu, Tambun dilantik menjadi ketua kampung yang baharu. Pada masa yang sama, Ribut, adik kepada Tambun yang berwajah hodoh ingin membalas dendam kepada Ujang kerana menolak cintanya dan memilih Seri sebagai teman. Ribut bersahabat dengan syaitan yang berjanji untuk menjadikannya seorang perempuan cantik. Sejak itulah Ribut berusaha untuk membalas dendam sehingga berlaku beberapa siri kematian yang penuh misteri.

programme.title: Duhai Si Pari-Pari
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Syadon, seorang pemuda yang mencintai Mala. Pada suatu hari, Syadon bertemu seorang gadis bernama Pari yang sedang mencari kekasihnya. Semakin hari, Pari semakin suntuk waktu yang Pari ada untuk mengahwini jejaka idamannya dan pulang ke dunia kayangan. Syadon bertanya siapakah Pari yang sebenarnya dan setelah diterangkan, dia sukar mempercayainya. Pari terpaksa membuktikan kata-katanya dengan menunaikan permintaan Syadon.

programme.title: Dendam Dari Pusara
programme.desc: Dolah, seorang buruh kasar yang cacat kaki sejak kecil mempunyai ilmu luar biasa yang diperolehinya dengan memotong dagu si mati dijadikan minyak tetapi perlu mematuhi syarat ketat dengan memulangkan barang-barang yang diperolehi dalam tempoh seribu hari. . Dolah melakukan kerja ngeri ini dengan bantuan dua orang kawannya, tetapi pada suatu masa dia telah gagal memenuhi syarat tersebut dan bermacam kejadian telah berlaku selepas itu.

programme.title: Karipap-Karipap Cinta
programme.desc: Ali bekerja sebagai jurufoto di syarikat penerbitan majalah jatuh hati kepada Sarah, seorang lulusan Universiti Al-Azhar. Ali panik apabila rakan serumahnya memberitahu keluarga Sarah ingin menjodohkannya dengan seorang ustaz. Untuk memenangi hati Sarah dan keluarganya, Ali terpaksa berbohong dengan mengatakan dia juga merupakan seorang graduan Universiti Al-Azhar. Dalam masa yang sama bos Ali, Dato Razali Bunari cuba mendedahkan satu skandal yang turut melibatkan bapa Sarah.

programme.title: Sate

Kadir ingin menyertai Anugerah Saintis untuk memenangi hadiah utama dan sekaligus menyenangkan hidup Milah. Pelbagai rintangan terpaksa dia lalui untuk mencipta mesin miliknya dan akhirnya Kadir berjaya menyiapkan mesin tersebut dan menyertai pertandingan itu.

programme.desc: Nita merancang untuk menikahi teman lelakinya, Idris. Berasal dari keluarga yang kaya, Nita merasakan ibunya bersikap seperti seorang majikan kerana kesibukan kedua orang tuanya. Nita menagih kasih sayang kedua ibu bapanya. Ingin bertunang dengan Idris namun ibunya ingin menjodohkan Nita bersama anak Datuk Hamzah.

programme.title: Vital Lifeline
programme.desc: Urban dwellers often experience a hectic pace of life and high levels of stress, making them more susceptible to health problems. The Strongest Lifeline helps you unravel the secrets to good health. To start, the program features a four-episode series on common urban pain issues, covering headaches, shoulder and neck pain, back pain, and joint pain. Each episode invites medical experts to explain the causes of these conditions, as well as physical therapists and exercise specialists to teach appropriate exercises. With the growing trend of integrating Eastern and Western medicine, even American swimming champion Michael Phelps uses cupping therapy to relieve pain. Therefore, each episode also includes traditional Chinese medical diagnosis, complemented by treatments such as acupuncture, cupping, and the Sanfu herbal patch therapy, which is especially suitable during the hottest days of summer. In addition, Chinese medicine practitioners share recipes for nourishing soups, all of which can help regulate and improve your health.

programme.desc: Public relations queen TONG MAN-LEI Jinny Ng raises her Gen Z daughter TONG SUM Desta Lee alone and she is a control freak. programme.title: Narcotics Heroes
programme.desc: Against the backdrop of neon lights in Hong Kong, there is a hidden dark side that nobody knows - the city is the hub of narcotics from all over the world. Rewind ten years and Narcotics Bureau has apprehended Man Wah, aka Drug Lord Moses Chan. However, undercover officer Ip Ho-tin Edwin Siu is sacrificed as he is injected with a colossal dose of dope, and he has since lost his feelings. Fast-forward ten years and Man Wah suffers from cancer and is given pardon and released from prison. He seemingly lives out the rest of his life by running some upstairs bookstore. programme.title: Gourmet Express
programme.desc: Hong Kong brings together global cuisines, and its unique dishes and down-to-earth fare have captured the close attention of discerning food lovers! Food hosts and presenters such as Icy Wong,Snowy Choi,Carmen Ngai,Carmaney Wong , Jessica Liu , Gillian Ng keep up with the latest food news and deals, delving into the stories behind the flavors. Gathering firsthand information on popular eateries across various platforms, the hosts personally line up and taste the food, providing genuine reviews. Even takeout-only eateries with no dine-in option are in high demandwhat are the must-try picks? Running a food business inevitably comes with its own mix of sweet, sour, bitter, and spicy experiences. The production team follows the proprietors through their busy day, from sourcing ingredients and preparing materials to opening for business, uncovering the stories behind the flavors.

programme.title: Cantoxicating! Sr.4
programme.desc: The Cantonese word gaigui ?? is vivid and profound, with many Hong Kong slang terms originating from various parts of Guangdong Province. Gaigui Ambassador Mayanne Mak has expanded her exploration to China, inviting Tang Chi-kin, Thye Cho-yee, and Hui Man-hin to join the Gaigui Guided Tour to delve into inland cities like Guangzhou, uncovering interesting anecdotes and origins. Professional Cantonese and historical experts will also appear, tracing origins and citing classical texts to reveal the charm of local Cantonese. Furthermore, Tang Chi-kin, who enjoys playing pranks, will transform into a single, nerdy man on the show, showcasing his pursuit of various goddesses and helping viewers understand the meanings of many slang terms and idioms.

programme.title: ChatSAT
programme.desc: It will do its utmost to gather the trendiest and latest information from around the world, covering everything from global events, medical encyclopedias, arts, and technology to daily life and trending online topics, sharing them with the audience every Saturday. By discussing everything under the sun and chatting about the hottest topics, Group friend listeners can easily stay up to date with global trends by following the program.

programme.title: Try It? Really? Sr.2
programme.desc: Elena Kong once again leads the team, joining forces with Cheung Chun-long, Chu Man-han, Ng Yip-kwan, and Tseng Zhan-wang to form the Try It Out Team, returning with acclaim after the hit first season and enthusiastic praise from netizens. This new in-depth exploration of Taiwan will see the team continue their relaxed, authentic, and down-to-earth style, guiding viewers deep into the islands heart. The team travels to Kaohsiung, Tainan, and Taipei, continuing the shows spirit by uncovering controversial shops with polarized online reviews, as well as hidden gems and little-known experiences tucked away in the citys corners. The team is committed to presenting the most genuine on-site feedback, aiming to create a practical travel guide to Taiwan that avoids pitfalls for viewers.

programme.title: A Date with Goddess Sr.2
programme.desc: The dating reality show A Date with Goddess is back with a bang, and the second seasons love battlefield is all upgraded! Golden Matchmaker Bob Lam is recruiting men from around the world to pair up goddesses Ho Pei-Chia, Kuo Pei-Wen, Chen Ruo-Si, Yu Ke-Cheng, and Yuen Ka-Man. The brave suitors face challenges like pressing the heart-fluttering light and a date at the Five Corners, each employing their own unique strategies to win over the goddesses. One-on-one intimate games ignite heart-pounding excitement, and a hidden goddess joins the fray, further intensifying the sparks More challenges await, and the brave suitors strive to reach the end and capture the goddesses hearts! In addition, the five goddesses from last season, along with celebrity guests, take turns becoming the Peanut Team, providing live coverage of the goddesses dates.

programme.title: Neighborhood Treasures Sr.7
programme.desc: Sammy and Kitty, this quirky duo, reunite on screen, this time as secret agent leaders, delivering hilarious clips from Taiwan, Japan, and Hong Kong to the audience. Each episode features celebrity guests divided into two teams, each using their imagination to solve incredibly difficult puzzles related to the hilarious clips alongside the leader. They can also ask two beautiful fun agents for hints, but theyll have to judge for themselves which information is true and which is false. The worst-performing guest will receive retraining from the leaderwhat punishment awaits the guests?

programme.title: Only Fools Fall in Love
programme.desc: Zhao Fu Lau Ching-wan is the head of the Zhao family. Although wealthy, powerful, and exceptionally intelligent, his sharp-tongued and competitive nature prevents him from finding happiness. The second-in-command, Zhao Ji Dayo Wong, has long harbored resentment towards Fu, compounded by his debts from gambling, drinking, and prostitution. He persuades Wang Di Ng Sin-lin, a street performer, to enter into a sham marriage with Fu to swindle a dowry. Di and her father Yuen Wah, wanting to settle down, agree. Before the wedding ceremony, Fu tries to steal fireworks, but Ji changes tactics, causing Fu to fall from a height in the chaos, leaving him mentally impaired. Realizing the gravity of the situation, Di and her father flee, changing their surnames and starting a new life. Ji considers killing Fu, but Fu escapes. Fate brings Fu and Di together again. At a market, Di sees Fu as a beggar, living a life of hardship, and driven by guilt and compassion, takes him in. As they spent more time together, feelings blossomed between them. The younger brother found it hard to believe he was moved by the sincerity of a simpleton, while Fu experienced unprecedented joy in love. On a beautiful, sunny day, Ji sent men to disrupt Fu and the younger brothers world, also affecting their neighbors. Fu and the younger brother decided they had to take advantage of their fair and impartial great-uncles Qiao Hong birthday banquet to return to the Zhao family, expose Jis evil deeds, and seek justice. Thus, a simpleton formally declared war on a cunning and treacherous man

programme.desc: In a media landscape flooded with misinformation, this current affairs programme cuts through the noise with sharp analysis and investigative reporting. Hosted by Lee Cheng Hao, the show uncovers hidden issues and speaks up for the people, delivering clarity and accountability in every episode.

programme.title: Mommy Says
programme.desc: A warm and relatable lifestyle talk show that explores the daily dynamics between mothers, daughters-in-law, and modern families. Through real stories, lighthearted conversations, and practical tips on relationships, parenting, and home life, the program highlights touching and humorous moments.

programme.title: Family Reunion
programme.desc: A lively grandmother, a warm-hearted couple and their four daughters run a tangyuan shop. Working together to prepare glutinous rice balls for every joyful occasion, the family transforms its modest business into a neighbourhood symbol of warmth, togetherness and reunion.

programme.title: The Tradition Story of Taiwan
programme.desc: The Tradition Story of Taiwan dramatises folk tales, legends and local beliefs passed down through generations. Drawing on Taiwans rich cultural heritage, each story explores the lives, values and supernatural traditions of different communities.

programme.title: Taste of Life
programme.desc: Chu-Tsai Chao and his wife have five children. Having devoted his entire life to developing soy sauce products, Chu-Tsai sincerely hopes that one of his children will follow in his footsteps and take over the family business. However, he also respects their individual passions and aspirations. Because of their fathers dream of innovation, the lives of the Chao brothers are about to change.

programme.title: Taste of Life
programme.desc: Chu-Tsai Chao and his wife have five children. Having devoted his entire life to developing soy sauce products, Chu-Tsai sincerely hopes that one of his children will follow in his footsteps and take over the family business. However, he also respects their individual passions and aspirations. Because of their fathers dream of innovation, the lives of the Chao brothers are about to change.

programme.title: Venus Online
programme.desc: Venus Online is a vibrant lifestyle and beauty show featuring the latest in makeup, skincare, and fashion. Each episode shares practical tips and fun challenges that inspire confidence and celebrate personal style.

programme.title: The 61st Broadcast Golden Bell Awards 61
programme.desc: Hosted by Ou Mark at Taipei Music Center, the 61st Broadcast Golden Bell Awards recognises outstanding radio programmes, presenters and production professionals. Through award presentations and industry reflections, the ceremony celebrates creativity, public service and the lasting role of radio in connecting communities across Taiwan. 61

programme.title: Show Biz
programme.desc: Show Biz delivers fast-paced coverage of the latest celebrity news, entertainment events and popular culture. Through studio segments, interviews, live reports and highlights, the programme keeps viewers informed about current stars, performances and industry developments.

programme.title: American Girl
programme.desc: 13 year-old Fen is uprooted from LA and moves to Taipei in early 2003, when her mother is diagnosed with breast cancer. She struggles to adjust to her new life with a new school and long-separated father, and drifts away from her mother. When her younger sister is misdiagnosed with SARS, they finally open up to each other during quarantine.

programme.title: Shadows Edge, The
programme.desc: A team of skilled thieves pulls off a massive billion-dollar heist while outsmarting the Sky Eye surveillance system, shocking the city. To stop the criminals before they strike again, Macau police enlist retired surveillance expert Wong Tak Chung to rebuild an elite tracking squad and hunt down the elusive mastermind behind the operation.

programme.title: Dead To Rights
programme.desc: During the 1937 Nanjing Massacre, civilians hiding in Ji Xiang Studio are forced to develop film for the Japanese army, only to uncover photographic evidence of its atrocities. Risking execution if discovered, they decide to preserve the negatives and expose the truth, determined to reveal the horrors of the massacre to the world.

programme.title: The Vanished Murderer
programme.desc: Set in Northern China in 1932, inmate Fu Yuan escapes from prison by digging a tunnel with a silver spoon. Inspector Song Dong Lu is assigned to investigate the case. Following letters sent by Fu, Song travels to Hong City to uncover the mystery behind her disappearance, facing deeper conspiracies along the way.

programme.title: The Goldfinger
programme.desc: Inspired by Hong Kongs biggest financial scandal in the 1980s, this is a rags to riches story about Ching Yat Yin who is chairman of a listed company. With Chings wealth and influence on the rise, ICAC senior investigator Lau Kai Yuen is determined to investigate the case, even if it means spending 15 years in pursuit of the truth.

programme.title: Ghost Wedding
programme.desc: Photographer Zhi Cheng is entangled with a woman in red, leading to the deaths of his relatives one by one. When the girl he likes, Si Tong, also dies mysteriously, Zhi Cheng vows to find out the truth but ends up revealing the secret of a ghost marriage...

programme.title: Hk Lan Kwai Fong
programme.desc: Lee is the Production head of an advertising firm who tries to improve her teams performance by competing with Creative head Chan in the day and clubbing at Lan Kwai Fong for ideas at night. Lee runs into her ex-boyfriend before a big commercial shoot and drowns her sorrows drinking at Lan Kwai Fong, but finally picks herself up with Chans help.

programme.title: Moscow Mission
programme.desc: The story is based on a 1993 true event, the China-Russia Train Robbery where a gang of criminals commits a heist, stealing cash and goods from the cross border train. A Chinese police officer disguises as a businessman heads the operation to arrest the criminals, but uncovers a bigger conspiracy instead

programme.title: Way We Talk, The
programme.desc: This is a soul-searching story about three youths: Wolf, Sophie and Alan, each living with a different form of deafness. Through sign language, they cultivate a profound friendship and offer each other unwavering support. United by love and friendship, the trio embarks on a journey of self-discovery and resilience.

programme.title: Untouchable
programme.desc: Zun Fei becomes the right-hand man to Macau tycoon Huang, whose hands are deep in both legal and illegal businesses. However, facing underworld violence, power struggles and moral dilemmas, Fei is torn between love and justice. Soon, he finds himself trapped in a deadly gamble set against him, with his life at stake.

programme.title: I Want to be Rich
programme.desc: Young Wah rises from a poverty-stricken background, carrying the heavy burden of caring for his gambling-addicted parents and younger siblings. Against all odds, his resilience and determination to provide a better life for his family eventually lead him to achieve significant success in real estatea testament that perseverance pays off.

programme.title: Victims
programme.desc: A ruthless Kuala Lumpur high school student kills his classmate, exposing the contrasting struggles of the victims mother and the murderers mother as they uncover their sons hidden secrets, while inching closer to a heartbreaking truth.

programme.title: Hit N Fun
programme.desc: Former Muay Thai legend Zhong Lei trains pro fighters despite his gyms struggles. When ad executive Lin learns her boyfriend is cheating with a champion boxer, she challenges her rival to a match and undergoes brutal training under Zhong. Through the grueling process, Lins quest for revenge transforms into a journey of self-discovery.

programme.title: Trending Topic
programme.desc: Chen Miao, an online media editor-in-chief, wrote a popular article which has become a trending topic. This however, led indirectly to a girls suicide. After receiving a help request, she realises that there is more to the story than meets the eye. As public opinion sways on the case, a war to speak up for the weak has begun!

programme.title: I Did It My Way
programme.desc: As the secretive, complex world of online drug trafficking increasingly targets Hong Kong, the police launches a risky and top-secret sting operation to bring down one of the most notorious drug lords in Asia.

programme.title: Old Fox
programme.desc: In 1989, young Liao Jie and his father save for a home, unaware of rising property prices. Frustrated by poverty, he learns from their landlord Old Fox who teaches him survival in society. Liao Jie ends up hurting Old Fox with what he has learnt, but his empathy prevents him from becoming like Old Fox.

programme.title: Atonement
programme.desc: Single father Ah Long lives a humble life with his beloved daughter, believing kindness will always be rewarded. However, when she is abducted during a trip to Thailand, his faith shatters. Desperate to find her, he marries a local Chinese woman to remain in the country and hunt down a human trafficking ring, becoming a blood-soaked avenger.

programme.title: The Singing Thief
programme.desc: A master jewel thief turns over a new leaf as a professional singer in a nightclub. However, a series of robberies happened shortly after and he becomes the suspect again. The thief then sets up a trap to snare the copycat but will this backfire on him?

programme.title: The Tiger and the Widow
programme.desc: The Liu Chia-liang trained Hui Ying-hung was considered the top action martial arts female star in the 1980s. It is her martial arts abilities that Michelle Yeoh tries to emulate. In The Tiger and the Widow, Hui Ying-hung is somehow mixed up in a salt smuggling ring that stinks of missing persons and rotten dilemmas.

programme.title: Six Assassins
programme.desc: Lord Li Ming is a feudal tyrant who oppresses the people, and even the Emperor who is his brother, cannot stop his evil act. Righteous swordsman Mu poses as Li Mings guard to plan for his assassination. He arrests six assassins who have tried to kill Li Ming, before making them his allies in a secret plot to kill him and end the tyranny.

programme.title: A Maid From Heaven
programme.desc: The seventh daughter of the Jade Emperor is banished from heaven to live a mortal life as she is very mischievous. She falls in love with a young village lad Yong, who sold himself to work for the rich so as to bury his father. The goddess sisters help Yong to pay his debt so the lovebirds can be together. Is this going to end happily-ever-after?

programme.title: Dragon Swamp
programme.desc: Fan is cheated by her lover Tong to steal her masters Jade Dragon Sword. She is jailed in the Dragon Swamp as punishment and gave birth to a pair of twins - her daughter is raised by her master, while her son is taken by Tong. Twenty years later, the sword is stolen again and Fans daughter goes seeking for it, meeting Fans friend along the way.

programme.title: Sunset
programme.desc: Teenage heart-throbs Ching Li and Paul Chin Pei come across like Annette Funicello and Frankie Avalon in the musical Sunset, a musical romp that plays similar to one of Hollywoods famous Beach Party movies. A car load of girls meets a car load of boys, and Ching and Paul ultimately fall in love. Yet the film takes an acrid twist and turns out to be more like a Shakespearian tragedy than a beach-babe party.

programme.title: The Flying Dagger
programme.desc: The Yu family and the Green Dragon clan became enemies when the Yu daughter killed the clan heads son, who was a rapist and murderer. The Green Dragon leader wounds the head of the Yu family with his flying daggers, and a wandering swordsman saves the family using his own flying dagger skills. However, his allegiances and motives are unclear.

programme.title: Whose Baby is in the Classroom?
programme.desc: Chen, a male teacher in an all girls high school, is stuck with a baby that isnt his and must take care of it. As he lives on the school grounds, the baby is a source of constant distraction and worry! Luckily, his class warms to the baby and helps him take care of it while he works his charm on Li Ching, an uptight teacher in the same school.

programme.title: The Magnificent Swordsman
programme.desc: The Magnificent Swordsman centres on the hero who vows vengeance against evil bandits who killed his family when he was a child. The hero recruits several friends to help the peasants rid their village of marauding bandits, the leader of the band being the man who killed his family.

programme.title: Facets Of Love
programme.desc: Set in the Ming Dynasty, the story revolves around a brothel and the girls who work there. The film begins by following the life of a girl from a poor family, who is sold by her mother to the brothel. While she is the most beautiful of the girls and attracts many clients, the girl hopes to escape this sad way of life one day.

programme.title: The Scandalous Warlord
programme.desc: General Feng occupies the city of Shandong, and soldiers and civilians alike welcome him without knowing his tyrannical and lustful nature. His first official business is to inspect the brothels and take the prostitutes home to become his concubines. Feng is finally killed by his officers, but will the new general rule the city differently?

programme.title: Ghosts Galore
programme.desc: Young Taoist priest Lu and his friend are nearly killed by a female ghost during an exorcism. Luckily, Master Lian saves their lives, so they beseech him to teach them his skills. When his friend is killed by ruthless ninjas, Lu decides to learn the ultimate witchcraft and teams up with his master to defeat them.

programme.title: Mr. Funnybone Strikes Again
programme.desc: In this hilarious sequel, Mr Big Potato opens an old-fashioned Chinese clinic, but his traditional methods are rejected by the sceptics of modern Hong Kong. Enter his buddy Mr Funny bone to rescue his business!

programme.title: The Water Margin
programme.desc: This is a martial arts epic directed by Chang Cheh. In the Sung Dynasty, the government is run by corrupt officials, so Sung Jiang gathers 108 outlaws at Mount Liang and establishes a band of patriotic heroes to end the repression of brutal overlords.

programme.title: The Story of Sue San
programme.desc: TIn this Huangmei Opera romance, Wang is the son of a respected government official whereas Sue San is a famous prostitute. Although they love each other and seem to be perfectly matched, the two are worlds apart when it comes to social ranking, which will prove hard to overcome...

programme.title: The Bully
programme.desc: For lovers of the Shaws sumptuous production and martial arts expertise, this action adventure in the Jackie Chan style is a special treat. A persecuted waiter turns to a drunken master for help when a restaurant customer turns out to be a kung-fu harbinger of doom!

programme.title: Enchanting Shadow
programme.desc: A young scholar Ning spends the night in a creepy temple that is said to be haunted. He does not believe in the rumours, but soon meets a beautiful female ghost Nie. Nie is forced to stay in the temple to seduce young men for a powerful demon to feast on. Knowing Nie to be a kind ghost, Ning decides to help her escape from the demons clutches.

programme.title: The Lady Professional
programme.desc: Lily Ho is perfectly cast as a gun-for-hire who always gets her man - in more ways than one! The cast and crew shot on location in Japanese scenic spots such as Mount Fuji and there are plenty of over-the-top thrills, as Lily even masquerades as a nun.

programme.title: Rear Entrance
programme.desc: Mrs Xu is childless and watches a lonely little girl playing at the rear entrance from afar every day. She warmly nurtures the girl and even adopts her from her uncaring parent. The girl brings happiness to the Xus until her long lost mother appears one day and to make her happy, Mrs Xu reluctantly lets the girl reunite with her mother.

programme.title: Executioners From Shaolin
programme.desc: The White-Browed Priest supports the brutal Qing government, burning down Shaolin Temple and hunting its disciples. Shaolins Hung falls in love with Fang while escaping the hunt and the couple have a son before Hung is killed by the Priest. To avenge his father, Hungs son creates a new form of martial art combining his parents kung fu styles.

programme.title: The Voyage of Emperor Chien Lung
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung continues his incognito voyage to southern China. Accompanied by the minister and the imperial scholar, they have many amusing encounters in Yangzhou.

programme.title: My Dear Bootham
programme.desc: Pannu finds a magic lantern and releases the Genie King, Karkimuki. Karkimuki helps Pannu solve his daily problems with magical solutions and friendship.

programme.title: Rajini Murugan
programme.desc: Rajini Murugan, an unemployed youth, falls in love with Karthika, his cousin. But Karthikas father opposes the match.

programme.title: Picket 43
programme.desc: In the desolate Kashmir region, an Indian officer forms an unlikely bond with a Pakistani soldier, transcending borders amid the ongoing conflict.

programme.title: Annapoorani
programme.desc: A girl born in an orthodox family aspires to become Indias best chef. She faces events and challenges on her way and goes beyond her conventional beliefs and prejudices to achieve her dream.
After mobiles start mysteriously flying out of the hands of people in Chennai, Dr Vaseegaran summons his trusted robot Chitti to ward off the bird-shaped supernatural powers of Pakshirajan.

programme.title: Diya
programme.desc: After her abortion, a womans life gets wild when she starts seeing her grown fetus, who appears to guide her through unexpected emotions and challenges.

programme.title: Free Ticket
programme.desc: The host presents a curated compilation of hit songs and memorable snippets from the most popular and trending Tamil movies, celebrating the best of Tamil cinema.

programme.title: Samar
programme.desc: Shankar and Roopa fall in love with each other but she suddenly ends their relationship and moves out of the country. Shankar receives a mysterious invitation from Roopa to come to Bangkok.

programme.title: Captain
programme.desc: Gangster Soori, known as Captain, aids people in need. Meeting Nisha brings transformative love. Will his past hinder a new beginning?

programme.title: Bhairavakottai
programme.desc: Basava and John, in a heist gone wrong, stumble upon mysteries in Bhairavakona, unraveling its secrets with Geethas help.

programme.title: Veetla Visesham
programme.desc: Elango, a 26-year-old man, is shocked to discover that his mother is pregnant. His struggle to come to terms with the news puts his relationship with his girlfriend, Sowmya, in jeopardy.

programme.desc: A couple dies under mysterious circumstances and Insp. Deepak is assigned the case. He loses his leg during the investigation, which ends his career.

programme.title: 无间道III: 终极无间
programme.desc: 2004年，陈永仁被杀后十个月，刘建明被架空职权，只负责琐碎的工作这时，年轻警司杨锦荣成为警队内的新星，但刘建明推测杨锦荣可能同是黑帮派入警队的卧底决定重新做人的刘建明一方面要置杨锦荣于死地，一方面却要提防自己身份曝光

programme.title: 爱的世界
programme.desc: 李子良丧妻后，与两个儿子相依为命妻子的巨额医药费令子良经济十分拮据，受同事教唆往马场孤注一掷，迫得向高利贷借款，从此子良债台高筑，疲于奔命，没有时间与儿子沟通，父子疏离与此同时高利贷不断登门恐吓，骚扰儿子，最终弄至悲剧发生

programme.title: 赌侠
programme.desc: 自赌神高进退隐后，其徒刀仔在赌坛崭露头角然而，盛名之下暗箭难防，各方强敌纷纷觊觎其地位与名号身陷连场赌局与重重阴谋，刀仔凭藉超群胆识与过人智慧见招拆招，最终在这场巅峰较量中，成功捍卫了赌神之名

programme.title: 鹿鼎记
programme.desc: 韦小宝被反清复明的天地会被派到皇宫当卧底，受命查探四十二章经下落韦小宝很快成为康熙皇帝的心腹，但他既要执行天地会的任务，最后陷入两难的状态

programme.title: 法中情
programme.desc: 摄影师田迪文强奸模特儿凌祖儿，幸得大律师叶颖文洗脱控罪颖文男友高级督察方伟负责此案，不满女友是非不分祖儿之妹凌珊珊替姐报仇，反遭田施暴，颖文再任其辩护律师珊珊因过往不良纪录，处处失利，能够令田入罪的机会极微；检控官决定请师兄龙约翰出山相助

programme.title: 济公
programme.desc: 周星驰饰演天庭中犯下天条的狂妄之神，被派往凡间化身为济公，并立志要感化三个注定沦为九世乞丐九世妓女及九世恶人之凡人如济公能于三天内顺利完成此事，他便可重返天庭

programme.title: 赤脚小子
programme.desc: 穷乡青年关丰曜，终日赤着双脚，以背人过河为活关父临终前，嘱其出城投靠段青云；段骤见故人之子，留下关在布店当小工关与私塾女教师华小莲交心，却遭莲父白眼；关为求出人头地，竟往投靠土霸喀和布，结果连累莲父与段相继被喀暗算身亡关得知真相，惜为时已晚，追悔莫及，决与喀拼过死活...

programme.title: 夜守
programme.desc: 在一次车祸后失忆的王人杰找到夜间警卫的工作午夜，他准时抵达废弃的大厦上班，却发现三只冤魂如约而至，并揭发了一场复仇计画究竟这是命运的安排还是邪灵的诅咒？

programme.title: 青蛙王子
programme.desc: 此喜剧在夏威夷开始，富家子为人腼腆，追女乏术，好友充当其爱情顾问，带他四出泡妞，却碰得一鼻子灰，闹出连场笑话

programme.title: 铁线功夫拳
programme.desc: 武术宗师梁坤为保护心爱的女人毅然退隐江湖，不料他的隐忍却换来了爱人的惨死意识到宿命避无可避，他重返武林，在丐帮帮主苏灿的鼎力相助下，梁坤杀出一条血路，誓要向那些冷血仇敌讨回血债

programme.title: 鹿鼎记 II
programme.desc: 神龙教教主龙儿奉命协助吴三桂推翻康熙皇帝，却反遭吴三桂陷害，幸得韦小宝相救才得以保命于是龙儿以身相许，并把绝世武功传于韦小宝以对付吴三桂最后，韦小宝更意外地从四十二章经中得知满清龙脉的秘密宝藏

programme.title: 头文字 D
programme.desc: 本片由日本同名殿堂级漫画改编而成故事描述十八岁的拓海，每天驾驶着父亲残旧的汽车送递豆腐，却无意中练得一手出神入化的飘移技术拓海被父亲怂恿参加山路赛，竟在众人错愕之下胜出，一夜成名，之后更面对一连串惊险绝伦的挑战赛！

programme.title: 九品芝麻官
programme.desc: 包龙星起初为清朝九品候补知县九品芝麻官，号称青天的包拯后裔，却无包拯维护公义的精神，接受地方土豪的贿赂而诬害忠良，以至人人喊打后来痛改前非，为一名含冤被判处死刑的女子申冤，历尽千辛万苦上燕京告御状，最后被封为八府巡按，在公堂辩论打败恶势力，告大白于天下

programme.title: 一代宗师
programme.desc: 这部史诗式动作电影是由著名电影人王家卫执导故事始于佛山，当时年迈的北方功夫宗师宫羽田公开挑战南方宗师叶问叶问最终胜出，但后来输给宫羽田的女儿宫二，二人却因此结下情缘

programme.title: 女人心
programme.desc: 有妇之夫孙子威与莉发展婚外情，其妻宝儿忍无可忍，决定离婚分居后，宝儿认识一群独身但不甘寂寞的女人，经常聚会，各自各精彩！子威后来发觉自己最爱的依然是宝儿，二人决定复合怎料在庆祝复合的晚会上，二人经过一场争吵，竟宣布第二度离异...

programme.title: 赌城大亨之新哥传奇
programme.desc: 取材自澳门赌王何鸿燊的真人真事，讲述由1930至1960年代赌王努力打拼至事业高峰的故事1941年日本入侵香港，年青大学生贺新逃离香港奔赴澳门贺新起初在码头做苦力，凭着他的胆色过人刻苦耐劳和聪明机智，最终登上澳门博彩业的第一把交椅

programme.title: 无敌幸运星
programme.desc: 富翁死前立下遗嘱，把财富全留给女儿飞飞，逼使其子秋少及侄儿大傻设法分一杯羹大傻派小混混幸运星往偷遗嘱，欲在遗嘱上做手脚，而秋少亦找来貌似其妹的阿凤假扮飞飞骗取遗嘱幸运星打算骗假飞飞结婚以夺取遗产，不料二人日久生情，最终幸运星在婚礼日揭发二人的诡计

programme.title: 青蛇：前缘

programme.title: 晚间新闻
programme.desc: 报导香港两岸国际重要新闻以及体育消息，让你洞悉各地大事及体坛动向

programme.title: 丫鬟大联盟 第6集
programme.desc: 以兵部侍郎裘府丫鬟月盈黄心颖饰为首的六部丫鬟组成联盟，互通消息，一起赚钱月皎汤洛雯饰为筹钱给爱郎傅有为谢东闵饰上京赴考，卖身为婢月盈与月皎分别服侍大夫人官之姵郭少芸饰和二夫人上官云英张慧仪饰，各为其主，互相斗法！少爷裘其进洪永城饰与月盈情投意合，可惜遭父裘正郑子诚饰打压裘正犯事被降职，其进决心考取功名，重振家声兵部尚书霍奔潘志文饰之女霍燕贞刘思希饰也看上有为，多番引诱月盈月皎害怕情郎高中后失去对方，誓要他们状元梦碎两对恋人面临决裂之际，竟卷入卖国漩涡中

programme.title: 他来自江湖 第9集
programme.desc: 明天原是黑道枭雄，因一次买卖令未婚妻意外身亡而大受打击，决洗心革面，经营联谊会为生明天与母亲舅父何英彪及表弟何鑫淼同住，英彪一直怀疑明天当年连累他被革离警队，故对他诸多单打，但明天并不介怀，鑫淼却视明天为偶像，两人情同手足，使英彪为之气结明天自未婚妻死后，本心如止水，不料邂逅余文骞及阮黛玉，感情生活泛起涟漪鑫淼为父误入歧途，牵涉入毒品买卖，明天为救鑫淼，联同警务督察旧友马世雄，与黑帮周旋

programme.title: 使徒行者3 第24集
programme.desc: 薛家强林峯饰完成三年卧底任务后，回港开设沐足店，继续收集情报刑事情报科总督察章纪孜黄智雯饰怀疑卓凯苗侨伟饰出狱后投入黑道，对他进行全面监视家强与卓凯卷入器官贩卖案，联同女卧底窦亚希蔡思贝饰及保安局调查官韦作荣马国明饰，合力捣破涉案集团保安局及后新设安全情报机构，并邀得徐天堂袁伟豪饰加入，接管刑事情报科的工作覃欢喜许绍雄饰逃过一死后，暗中调查某社团的秘密神秘社团原来由长兴已故龙头魏德信的弟弟魏德礼创立，他还设下布局，对家强卓凯等展开报复

programme.title: 碧血盐枭 第14集
programme.desc: 缉私营的聂致远马浚伟为剿灭盐枭窦家寨，故意扮作落难秀才博取盐枭之女窦胜雪杨怡的同情及收留，因而与窦胜雪建立了深厚的感情某天官府突然派兵剿寨，在混乱之中窦胜雪身受重伤并与聂致远及家人失散，幸得盐商胡坚郭峰之子胡亭轩黄浩然相救，并暂留胡府待找回双亲及聂致远，但窦胜雪却惊见父母的尸首被悬于城楼示众，而站在楼顶大义凛然地告诫众人不要贩卖私盐的官员，竟是令自己日夜牵肠挂肚的聂致远，窦胜雪柔肠寸断，且对聂致远有彻骨之恨...

programme.title: 八卦神探 第15集
programme.desc: 薛丹仁李思捷是一名普通警员，但他非等闲之辈，因他在玄学上深得外公真传，每每在关键时刻，为许多奇案破解谜团，加上黑白通吃的好友梁醒裘梁烈唯作线人，其出众的作风常令上司车季菲万绮雯啧啧称奇，季菲拥有犯罪心理学专家资格，事事只凭理性，二人看似南辕北辙，但内里却因合作蕴酿了一种不能言语的默契，但季菲一副管家婆模样，工作以外只关心妹妹车季美杨诗敏和弟弟车季君郑俊弘的终身大事，当季美陷入醒裘和下属铁良芷朱晨丽的三角关系时，季菲情绪失控，幸得丹仁出手相助此际，城中发生连环失踪案，诱拐手法勾起了丹仁隐藏多年的往事，季菲不惜以身犯险，丹仁却算到

programme.desc: 薛丹仁李思捷是一名普通警员，但他非等闲之辈，因他在玄学上深得外公真传，每每在关键时刻，为许多奇案破解谜团，加上黑白通吃的好友梁醒裘梁烈唯作线人，其出众的作风常令上司车季菲万绮雯啧啧称奇，季菲拥有犯罪心理学专家资格，事事只凭理性，二人看似南辕北辙，但内里却因合作蕴酿了一种不能言语的默契，但季菲一副管家婆模样，工作以外只关心妹妹车季美杨诗敏和弟弟车季君郑俊弘的终身大事，当季美陷入醒裘和下属铁良芷朱晨丽的三角关系时，季菲情绪失控，幸得丹仁出手相助此际，城中发生连环失踪案，诱拐手法勾起了丹仁隐藏多年的往事，季菲不惜以身犯险，丹仁却算到

programme.title: 丫鬟大联盟 第7集
programme.desc: 以兵部侍郎裘府丫鬟月盈黄心颖饰为首的六部丫鬟组成联盟，互通消息，一起赚钱月皎汤洛雯饰为筹钱给爱郎傅有为谢东闵饰上京赴考，卖身为婢月盈与月皎分别服侍大夫人官之姵郭少芸饰和二夫人上官云英张慧仪饰，各为其主，互相斗法！少爷裘其进洪永城饰与月盈情投意合，可惜遭父裘正郑子诚饰打压裘正犯事被降职，其进决心考取功名，重振家声兵部尚书霍奔潘志文饰之女霍燕贞刘思希饰也看上有为，多番引诱月盈月皎害怕情郎高中后失去对方，誓要他们状元梦碎两对恋人面临决裂之际，竟卷入卖国漩涡中

programme.title: 他来自江湖 第10集
programme.desc: 明天原是黑道枭雄，因一次买卖令未婚妻意外身亡而大受打击，决洗心革面，经营联谊会为生明天与母亲舅父何英彪及表弟何鑫淼同住，英彪一直怀疑明天当年连累他被革离警队，故对他诸多单打，但明天并不介怀，鑫淼却视明天为偶像，两人情同手足，使英彪为之气结明天自未婚妻死后，本心如止水，不料邂逅余文骞及阮黛玉，感情生活泛起涟漪鑫淼为父误入歧途，牵涉入毒品买卖，明天为救鑫淼，联同警务督察旧友马世雄，与黑帮周旋

programme.title: 使徒行者3 第25集
programme.desc: 薛家强林峯饰完成三年卧底任务后，回港开设沐足店，继续收集情报刑事情报科总督察章纪孜黄智雯饰怀疑卓凯苗侨伟饰出狱后投入黑道，对他进行全面监视家强与卓凯卷入器官贩卖案，联同女卧底窦亚希蔡思贝饰及保安局调查官韦作荣马国明饰，合力捣破涉案集团保安局及后新设安全情报机构，并邀得徐天堂袁伟豪饰加入，接管刑事情报科的工作覃欢喜许绍雄饰逃过一死后，暗中调查某社团的秘密神秘社团原来由长兴已故龙头魏德信的弟弟魏德礼创立，他还设下布局，对家强卓凯等展开报复

programme.title: 那些我爱过的人 第4集
programme.desc: 七年前一宗严重车祸，破坏了两个家庭，改变了姜煜诚林文龙饰方乐汶黄翠如饰的人生七年后一次交通意外，让煜诚重遇乐汶，生活仍然有悲有喜乐汶与妹妹方书文连诗雅饰因身边人逐一离开而闹僵，没想到行为怪异的医生古希晨马贯东饰，却能直捣问题根源乐汶忙于照顾女儿朱幸而及继子朱嘉炳顾定轩饰，煜诚则一直未能了解独女姜子优苏皓儿饰的需要子优和嘉炳因缘走近，共同朋友莫宇谦李任燊饰竟为此段关系衍生更多问题，也令当年车祸真相渐渐浮现，众人亦要再次面临改变

programme.title: 爱情食物链 第13集
programme.desc: 从事食品供应的鲁佳芳阮小仪样子平凡，身材矮小，年过三十仍欠缺恋爱经验，因一次苦瓜事件，帮助餐饮业才俊刘柏业陈智燊渡过难关，令这位高富帅欣赏到佳芳的内在美，并与她渐生情愫，佳芳的邻居兼好友高贵芬高海宁对此无法释怀，卖鱼出身的贵芬样貌身材皆属女神级数，千方百计也未能令柏业过电，却召来台湾担仔面继承者洪鱻金刚的青睐，洪鱻为亲近贵芬不惜自贬身价与佳芳她们同住劏房，贵芬得不到柏业唯有转战二叔刘利高郑子诚，但后来柏业承受不了外界对女友佳芳的负评，二人关系亮起红灯；当爱情再不是饮水饱，美丑优劣再无标准，男女同时成了猎人与猎物，血肉横飞的恋爱激战即将一发不可收拾

programme.title: 逆天奇案2 第21集
programme.desc: O记干探许浚森陈展鹏饰沈韦力黄智贤饰奉命调查跨国罪案期间，得悉杀虎案幕后黑手魏子乐张颕康饰落网前，曾将神秘讯息发送至暗网，并汇出巨额加密货币不久有神秘人策动恐袭，浚森与韦力纵于天才教授唐冠峰方力申饰协助下破案，却惊觉子乐背后藏着更大阴谋！他们要竭力阻止子乐的同时，也遇到龙头棍风暴空屋藏白骨重犯越狱等奇案，能否一一扫除险阻？工作上面对的危机升级，感情亦遇挑战，浚森望跟前女友马颖思林夏薇饰复合，但困难重重令二人关系出现变量

programme.title: 大酱园 第19集
programme.desc: 万冠园是佛山酱油业百年老字号，大当家万启山吴岱融饰与夫人席德容龚慈恩饰坚持传男不传女，传内不传外的宗旨，可是一宗毒酱油事故，使他不得不答应让夏小满朱晨丽饰及叶细么龚嘉欣饰两女子加入，与其子万卓枫何广沛饰成为同期学徒三人与酱园小师傅华歌吴业坤饰建立了复杂的四角关系，又间接揭发了万家多个秘密，加上卓枫突然被掳走，人心惶惶酱园内，启山几个弟弟启石郑子诚饰启川陈嘉辉饰及启江徐荣饰酝酿分家，酱园外，专员高兆荣袁文杰饰也密谋夺取酱园财产，万冠园百年基业随时毁于一旦！

programme.title: 整点新闻

programme.title: 아기공룡 둘리
programme.desc: 아기공룡 둘리quot를 1983년부터 10년간 보물섬에서 연재하던 원작자 김수정씨는 국산 만화 캐릭터를 지속적이고, 세계적인 캐릭터로 성장 시키기 위해서는 조직적인 활동의 필요함을 느끼고 1995년 2월에 주둘리나라를 설립했다.1996년 7월 장편 만화영화 quot아기공룡 둘리quot를 제작하여 COEX 외 전국 극장에서 상영했으며 현재 미라클에서 비디오 테이프제작 판매중이다.1999년 1월 17일 베를린을 시작으로 독일극장에 상영했었고, 독일 영화개봉에 맞춰 음반 및 비디오, 게임도 같이 판매하는 큰 성과를 올렸다.

programme.desc: 土耳其梵貓是自然貓種, 不是由愛貓人育種而成牠們很強壯, 也是少數喜歡游泳的貓種雪鞋貓是暹羅貓的分枝, 育種人發現一窩小貓裡其中一隻有白色腳掌, 新貓種於焉誕生沙特爾貓是來自法國的古老品種, 從古至今都廣受法國名人喜愛孟加拉貓是野貓和家貓的稀有混種, 以斑紋著稱家貓是最多美國人養的貓, 你可以稱之為室內混種貓峇里貓被認為是絕頂聰明的貓種, 牠們是長毛版的暹羅貓, 而牠們和短毛貓一樣愛叫, 需要你時時關注

programme.title: 什麼玩意兒 第1季第2集
